name: Config error: storage_mode 'colunm' is not a valid value
description: storage_mode with a misspelled value must be rejected at config load rather than silently falling back to row storage (issue #187). Before the fix all three runtimes accepted it; the fallback DIRECTION had been aligned in #179 but the silence remained, so a typo produced a working engine whose memory and performance profile was the opposite of what was asked for. Message is byte-identical across the three runtimes. The byte-identical claim is pinned by wrapping_exact rather than only asserted in prose: with message_contains alone, rewording one runtime's message left section 05 green, so the claim had no gate at all.

expected_error.wrapping_exact: pine: config error: storage_mode "colunm" is invalid, must be "row" or "column"
